label: National swing since 2024
reading: In 2024 Trump won the national vote by 1.5 and Republicans won the House vote by 2.6. Our lock forecasts the 2026 House vote at D+8 (80% range +4 to +12), a swing of +9.5 points since 2024. The president's party lost House seats in 18 of the 20 midterms from 1946 to 2022. Every race below starts from its 2024 margin plus that swing.
